description: Intent i005 (branch ip-exthdr-tlv-walk, snapshot s01) complete. Two low-confidence structural variants of the seed mechanism reported, both with exact source evidence: (1) net/ipv6/exthdrs.c:140-148 ip6_parse_tlv() walks attacker-controlled hop-by-hop/destination TLVs and executes "int optlen = nh[off + 1] + 2;" reading the length byte when len==1 with no remaining>=2 check between consuming the type byte and reading the length byte (the optlen>len clamp in the default case comes after the read; PADN falls through with no per-TLV clamp); callers ipv6_destopt_rcv/ipv6_rthdr_rcv pskb_may_pull the full hdrlen, so the final-TLV len==1 read lands one byte past the pulled header region. (2) net/bridge/br_netfilter_ipv6.c:64-67 br_nf_check_hbh_len() has the identical shape with only a whole-header "(raw + len) - skb->data > skb_headlen(skb)" bound, no per-TLV 2-byte guarantee. Both mirror the mptcp_get_options fixed invariant; exploit impact (byte may still lie within skb linear area) is unproven, hence low confidence. Classified safe with explicit evidence: ip_options_compile (net/ipv4/ip_options.c:286, explicit l<2 check before optptr[1]), ipv6_find_tlv (exthdrs_core.c:133, offset+2>packet_len pre-check plus optlen>len clamp), calipso_tlv_len (calipso.c:834, offset+1>=opt_len check and offset+tlv_len>opt_len clamp), hbh_mt6 (ip6t_hbh.c:117, hdrlen<1 before type and hdrlen<2 before length via skb_header_pointer), ah6.c zero_out_mutable_opts/ipv6_rearrange_destopt (len<2 before opt[off+1]). Limitations: no runtime/KASAN reproducer built; mip6.c, output_core.c, ip6t_rt.c, ip6t_srh.c, seg6.c, exthdrs_offload.c walkers located but not deeply read.
